items.title: Venezuela earthquakes kill 920 people as international rescue teams arrive
items.description: Hundreds are still feared trapped under the rubble, as families desperate for news.

items.title: 'Every person saved is a miracle': Families call to trapped loved ones in region devastated by Venezuela quakes
items.description: Families keep vigil at buildings where they fear their loved ones are trapped, but face an impossible task to move heavy debris.

items.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon as Hezbollah condemns new deal
items.description: Strikes have killed at least one person, state media say a day after Lebanon and Israel signed a framework agreement.

items.title: Heatwave breaks records in Germany, Denmark and Czech Republic
items.description: An estimated 150 million people are now experiencing temperatures of over 35C across Europe.

items.title: Trump's face is added to select US passports for America's 250th birthday
items.description: The commemorative special edition passports will be available on 6 July, and can only be applied for in person

items.title: Religion row as Texas makes Bible stories required reading in schools
items.description: Critics say the new reading requirements infringe on religious freedoms and blur the separation of church and state.

items.title: US strikes Iran after attack on cargo ship
items.description: Iran accuses the US of violating their deal and says it struck targets linked to American forces in response.

items.title: Burkina Faso severs diplomatic ties with France
items.description: The West African country's junta accused the former colonial power of undermining its national interests.

items.title: Meloni and Trump: A very public fall-out that is proving very hard to fix
items.description: Italy's PM was not long ago being called the "Trump whisperer", but their relationship has gone from public attacks to personal insults.

items.title: Billionaire Leon Black walks out of Epstein investigation hearing
items.description: The House panel then issued subpoenas demanding the private equity tycoon, who co-founded Apollo Global Management, testify on camera and under oath.

items.title: Pete Buttigieg briefly separated from children after false police report
items.description: Buttigieg says the day he spent separated from his twins was "among the darkest hours of my life".

items.title: Ex-Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified documents
items.description: Bolton faces a prison sentence of up to five years and has agreed to pay $2.25m in fine, prosecutors say.
